subject: Acme SOC 2 discussion / post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme SOC 2 discussion / post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so the team is aligned and we have clear next steps. If I missed anything, please reply and I’ll update.

Summary of pain & goals (what we heard):
- Need intrusion-tolerant inference for PHI-adjacent traffic with clear auditability (audit logs + retained traces for 12 months).
- SOC 2 Type II evidence required for vendor onboarding.
- DPA and specific retention terms are required (customer wants 12 months storage, option to increase to 24 months).
- Pen test evidence and remediation history needed for infosec review.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- SOC 2 report (most recent) and supporting control descriptions.
- Audit logs: per-request metadata, redaction options, and configurable retention policies (we can set default to 12 months).
- Draft DPA for review and redline.
- Pen test summary and remediation notes (we can provide redacted artifacts and CVE tracking).

Agreed next steps (owners & ETA):
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 report + pen test summary + draft DPA by EOD Thursday (May 7). Owner: Marissa.
2) Acme to confirm specific retention window (12 vs 24 months) and internal regulator requirements by May 12. Owner: Alex / Priya.
3) Schedule procurement call to review commercial terms and SSO/KMS integration. Tentative week of May 18. Owner: Bill (procurement).

Attachments I will send in follow-up: SOC2 report (redacted), draft DPA, pen-test summary.

Short ask: Can you confirm the timeline for procurement and whether Acme requires on-prem/offline evidence (some auditors ask for physical pen-test artifacts)?

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, Bill Thompson <bill.thompson@acme-procurement.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 discussion / post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that summary looks right. A few clarifications from our side:
- Retention: default 12 months is fine; our legal team will confirm if they want an option for 24 months.
- Pen test artifacts: we do not need raw pcap or full exploit code; summary + remediation logs and CVE IDs are fine.
- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report and the control mapping to your product features (data handling, access controls, key management).

Procurement timing: we aim to start the commercial review week of May 18 but our security review needs the SOC2 + pen test summary before procurement signs off. If you can get materials by EOD Thursday that will keep us on schedule.

I’ll loop in Bill here to coordinate schedules.

Thanks,
Alex

Attached are the items we discussed: SOC 2 Type II (2025) redacted report, draft DPA (Acme-specific language flagged), and a pen test evidence summary. Links below as well for your legal and security teams:

Links & attachments:
- redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (attached)
- DPA_draft_Acme_v1.docx (attached)
- pen-test-evidence-summary.zip (attached; contains redacted findings and remediation timeline)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqR-SOC2-Acme
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4471
- DocuSign DPA envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/Acme-DPA-EnvelopeID-998877

Notes on controls & implementation (high level):
- Audit logs: We capture per-request metadata, authenticated user id, timestamp, model, route, and logs are tamper-evident via write-once storage. Retention is configurable; default is 12 months.
- Key management: Customers can use customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted integrations use Redwood-managed KMS with envelope encryption.
- Data handling: We offer optional request-level redaction and prefix caching controls for PII/PHI workloads.

Next steps:
- Marissa to share final attachments (sent now) and confirm DPA redline process.
- Alex / Priya to confirm retention window by May 12.
- Neha to coordinate SSO/KMS integration scoping call if procurement confirms schedule.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute security Q&A with our security lead (Rishi) next week to walk through the control mapping. Let me know two slots that work.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
